release_notes:
## Calm update chime

- Added an original, bundled C5-E5 two-note chime for the loading-screen update notification.
- The chime plays only once per game launch and only when an available-update banner is actually shown.
- Added an Update notification sound setting so the sound can be disabled without disabling update checks or badges.
- The cross-platform OGG resource is included in the Windows, Android32, and Android64 package.
